cinematic.title: Britain is reconnecting industry to a network that can no longer promise to keep the lights on.
cinematic.lede: The connections clearing fastest are non-firm — interruptible by contract. The market still prices damage; the loss is interruption. NFRI is the outside-in index that makes that gap legible.

hero.title: Who carries non-firm power risk — and who is prepared to underwrite it.
hero.lede: Reindustrialisation runs on affordable power. The queue is ~125 GW deep; firmness is now a register fact. This index scores carriers, MGAs, brokers, assets and reinsurers on two axes — and reduces each to a Margin of Safety the market does not yet publish.
hero.thesis: Exposure and Preparedness are orthogonal. Capacity deploys onto whoever looks exposed — but losses concentrate where exposure runs ahead of preparedness, while the genuinely capable sit in under-deployed whitespace.

pillars.title: Score the unscored
pillars.text: Like ai-transformation.fyi for PE portfolios: pick a population nobody has ranked — UK participants in non-firm power risk — and make the exposure legible from public evidence alone.

pillars.title: Encode the rubric
pillars.text: Ben Graham with a Bloomberg terminal: registers, filings and cited research fused in code. Scoring is arithmetic, never an LLM opinion — the builder discipline Boyle describes for physical-world companies.

pillars.title: Two axes, one number
pillars.text: Durability × Opportunity, recast as Exposure × Preparedness. The 2×2 is the argument: one glance should show who is carrying risk they cannot support.

pillars.title: Ship it honest
pillars.text: The dataset is the product. Mark what is measured, gate what is not, refuse synthetic data — the same honesty furniture as doloop and Ciridae.
